notes: Washington wines are known for bright fruit flavors and crisp acidity.
Cabernet and Merlot are often lush, with concentrated berry flavors such as blackberry, cherry and raspberry.
Good examples can usually age at least eight years.
Cabernet Franc is fruit-forward, with blueberry and raspberry.

blurb.text: The second-largest wine-producing US state, with nearly all its vineyards in the dry eastern half, in the rain shadow of the Cascades, where about ⟦rain|6 to 8 inches|150 to 200 mm⟧ of rain falls a year and summer days are long. Irrigation is key. Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot lead the red plantings.
